decision: D06 option 1: Newsreader 400 + 700 static Latin WOFF2 and system sans
authority: User instruction to proceed as recommended within the existing font budget

comparisons.description: @fontsource-variable/newsreader 5.3.0 Latin wght variable file (default optical size)

rationale: The recommended static pair fits the unchanged budget and matches both specified reading weights. It is 11,808 bytes smaller than the supplied Latin weight-variable file and uses the same fixed-weight files in node-canvas and the browser. System-only fallback is unnecessary.
coverage: Official Latin subset, 224 mapped code points; complete printable ASCII including Malay A–Z. Other scripts/unsupported characters use system font fallback. No canonical text was changed.
